sourceFacts: Fenglong Leibu drone test-station ground crew
skin is roughened by outdoor and hangar wind, and his gaze habitually follows the sky
usually quiet but becomes talkative about drones; latent orientation sense must not appear
designAssumptions: short brown hair, brown eyes, tan skin and light stubble
unmarked blue ground-crew jumpsuit with rolled sleeves, utility belt and work boots
industrial ear protection rests around the neck and a plain radio is clipped at the belt
2026-08-29 visual refresh: a rugged drone-control port behind one ear and layered airfield utility gear
sceneConcept: A wind-worn thirty-four-year-old Chinese drone test-station ground-crew worker stands alone against a transparent background. He wears an unmarked blue maintenance jumpsuit with rolled sleeves, work boots and industrial hearing protection around his neck, while a plain radio remains clipped to his utility belt. His arms rest naturally at his sides and his weathered face turns upward toward an unseen aircraft, under soft even frontal light without a drone, formation, interface or supernatural effect. Visual refresh: a rugged drone-control port behind one ear and layered airfield utility gear.
